summary: v2.28 web release verified end-to-end on backend + web UI. All 5 features + scope fix are working. Backend pytest 15/15 pass. Web UI verified across lead_manager (Fatema), super_admin (Sam), and account_manager roles. (1) Closer Queue: nav-closer-queue visible for LM/super_admin (hidden from AM); as LM, no 'Closer' column; as super_admin, 'Closer' column present. (2) Archive Bin: super_admin sees 1 archived lead in the bin, restore removes it (rows 1 -> 0). AM redirected off /crm/archive; nav-archive hidden. (3) Save Medicare View: as account_manager, ms-save prompt saves a view, chip persists across reload, ms-view-del removes it. (4) Territory Auto-Assign: backend returns 400 with no territory, 403 for non-admin, 200 with account_manager_name+team_name for admin+territory-linked team. (5) Daily Digest: admin edits hour/minute/tz and PUT persists (14:45 saved). Lead manager sees the card but all three inputs are disabled and the digest-save button is hidden; digest-send-now IS visible for lead_manager (backend requires MANAGER which allows lead_manager, matches spec). Scope fix confirmed: super_admin and admin see identical (full) counts for both leads and opportunities. Only outstanding item is the pre-existing cosmetic React hydration warning (<span> inside <option>) carried over from v2.27 — non-blocking.

issues: Carry-over from v2.27: React hydration console warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Non-functional; users see dropdown correctly. Ref: /app/frontend/src/pages/crm/Leads.js and/or Medicare.js saved-filter <select>.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Fix the pre-existing <span>-inside-<option> hydration warning in the saved-filter <select>.

Consider clarifying spec vs. implementation: 'Send now' (POST /crm/notifications/digest/run) is exposed to lead_manager, not admin-only. Review request describes non-admin as being able to 'view' but does not explicitly forbid triggering. If admin-only is desired, tighten the endpoint to require_admin.
Cleanup: Test suite creates 'ZZTEST v228 …' leads and 'ZZTEST_UI_…' saved searches. Tests archive/clean them, but a bulk-delete of anything with 'ZZTEST' in the name/org_name is safe if any linger.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_digest.py:70 POST /digest/run is guarded by MANAGER (lead_manager+), not admin. If admins should be the only ones triggering the digest send-now, change to require_admin. Otherwise, the frontend hint 'admin-only save + send-now' overstates the current guard.

routes_teams.py:216 route_to_territory sets territory once via _apply_assignment but only writes an activity for the reassignment — no activity entry captures the prior territory change made by /assign in the same UI action. Consider consolidating the two calls into one endpoint so the timeline shows a single 'admin routed to territory X (team Y)' event.
CloserQueue.js:19 uses `limit: 500` but PageHeader shows total as leads.length — misleading if there are more than 500 with-closer leads. Consider surfacing total from a headers/count or paginate.
Medicare.js saveSearch() blocks on window.prompt (Sonner UX would be nicer, but non-blocking).
ArchiveBin.js loads both archived leads + archived opps with limit 500. For large orgs this will truncate silently — add a 'showing 500 most recent' hint or pagination.
routes_crm.py list_leads: has_closer overrides closer_id if both are passed (line 194 reassigns query['closer_id']). Low risk but the frontend never combines them; document or short-circuit.
routes_digest.py digest_worker runs asyncio.create_task on server start (server.py:262) with no shutdown hook — a graceful stop hook would prevent orphan sends during redeploys.

Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration25_v228.py covers: super_admin sees ALL leads/opps parity with admin; POST /crm/leads/{id}/closer set + clear; GET /crm/leads?has_closer=true and ?closer_id=<uid>; POST /crm/leads/{id}/archive + /opportunities/{id}/archive archive+restore + AM 403; /crm/saved-searches CRUD as account_manager; POST /crm/leads/{id}/route-to-territory 400/403/happy path; digest settings GET/PUT (admin-only) + LM GET/PUT-403 + invalid-tz fallback + POST /digest/run.
